t: Pop in a Box Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of popinabox.co.uk
s: October 27, 2025 - Absolutely appalling, 2 very expensive items were packaged faulty was clear that they had been dropped prior to being packed by staff, i can confidentiality say this as the outer packaging was in very good undamaged condition , there's a reason why this site often has pokemon stock and thats because serious collectors know to avoid it due to poorly packaged items please read all reviews before purchasing, I am new to collecting and foolishly didn't read the reviews first, ask yourself this would you buy a ten pound burger from a burger shop with a three star health rating?
